articles.summary: The typical Airbnb host collects a review on only about 4 in 10 of their stays — and since five in six reviews are already 5 stars, the fastest way to more 5-star reviews is simply to collect more of the ones you've already earned. We measured the four levers that move it across 600+ hosts and a quarter-million stays.
articles.title: How to get more 5-star Airbnb reviews
